Meet LigTAS.

Community Flood Alert and Emergency Management System in Balagtas, Bulacan

A mobile and web-based capstone project supporting community flood preparedness and emergency coordination.

Explore the System ↓Research & Demo ↗
01 / About the project

Prepared communities start with better information.

LigTAS brings flood reports, alerts, and evacuation-related information into a connected system for residents, barangay officials, and local government personnel.

THE CHALLENGE

Fragmented emergency coordination

Flood-prone communities can face delays in reporting incidents, difficulty accessing timely advisories, and challenges coordinating evacuation activities.

THE SOLUTION

One connected platform

LigTAS supports flood reporting, emergency alerts, evacuation information, and coordination through mobile applications and a web dashboard.

02 / Capabilities

Built around community needs.

📍

Flood Reporting

Submit location-based flood reports to help authorities assess reported conditions.

📣

Alerts & Announcements

Share flood-related advisories and emergency information with residents.

🗺️

Map Monitoring

View reported incidents and location information on a map.

🏠

Evacuation Management

Access evacuation center information and support occupancy monitoring.

▦

Household QR

Support household identification and evacuation check-in workflows.

▥

LGU Dashboard

Manage reports, alerts, and emergency-related information in one interface.
